m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>You ready the Mustering Horn and take the deepest breath you can before giving it your all. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>The call warps and twists in the wind. It echoes off the rocky cliffs behind you, and soars over the waves. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>And then you feel an answering roar from the depths below that thrums in your bones. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You see a great shape slicing through the dark depths. You drop the Diving Bell in, and hope the magic works. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You step up to the Great Beast - you can't think of what else to call it. It's hard to even wrap your head around the idea of the thing. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Using the Diving Bell as a kind of psychic anchor, you project your will into the Great Beast. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>For a moment, the image of dark waves and tremendous hunger threatens to drown you. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>But you call upon your training, your sense of School, and the power of Light. And soon enough it's purring. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>Though its purr could probably shatter continents. </ITALICS>
With sloping scales and dripping maw, as who purused with yell and blow still treads the shadow of his foe, and forward bends his head,
The beast drove fast, loud roar'd the blast, and southward aye we fled.
Head to the Driftwood Docks and look for the ancient stone pier that lies just beyond.
Sound a call on the Mustering Horn, and then drop the Diving Bell you made into the tide. That should bring the Great Beast up.
This plan is disquieting. Yet I can see no other path for you to take. I pray the Celestial powers will keep you safe.
Keep your antennae twitching, and your head on a swivel. I am sure we will meet again, Spellbinder.
Go to the stone pier beyond the Docks. Sound the Mustering Horn, then drop the Diving Bell into the waves. I'll meet you there.
